blocks.title: One calm, gesture-first interface for every screen.
blocks.lead: Etesian runs on the KDE Plasma desktop, on LineageOS phones and on the web, from one design language. Its influence is the Nokia N9's Swipe UI, re-envisioned for how we use our screens today.

items.label: Etesian for KDE Plasma
items.text: The design language on the desktop.

items.label: The phone
items.text: Gestures, home views, lock screen, settings.

items.label: Apps
items.text: The everyday apps, rebuilt in the N9 style.

paragraphs: Etesian is an independent project and is not affiliated with Nokia. It credits the Nokia N9 (2011) as its inspiration and ships none of its assets: fonts, icons and sounds are open or made for the project.
